content.value: . A land based wind turbine power plant consists of 15 wind turbine of 0.6 MW size. The cut-in, rated and cut-out velocities of the turbines are 3.5, 12.5 and 25.0 m/s, respectively. The Weibull shape and scale factors at the farm site are 2.8 and 8.2 m/s, respectively. The life period is 25 years, the capacity factor of the turbine is 0.335, the total energy requirement of the land based wind turbine is 3806.2 GJ). Calculate the energy payback ratio and energy payback period of the farm.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
